title: Orchestr8 Model Catalog
description: Contract for config/models.yaml. Any catalog model may be assigned to any agent; per-agent allowed_models is a recommendation, not a gate. Validated by services.registry.validate_model_catalog() using the draft-07 subset validator in services.contracts.

provider.description: One upstream API. Keyed by provider id in models.yaml.

model.description: One selectable model. Keyed by the provider's API model id in models.yaml — the key is sent verbatim as the `model` field on the wire.

context.description: Advertised context window in tokens. Catalog metadata only — Orchestr8 does not enforce it.

price_in.description: USD per 1,000,000 input tokens. Estimate for the in-app cost readout.

price_out.description: USD per 1,000,000 output tokens. Estimate for the in-app cost readout.
